name: Nürburgring Nordschleife
layout: Nordschleife full lap from the T13 start/finish (20.832 km, industry-pool / Nordschleife-only lap)

sources.geometry: OpenStreetMap highway=raceway ways (Overpass API, (c) OSM contributors, ODbL): T13 - Hatzenbach - ... - Galgenkopf - Döttinger Höhe - Antoniusbuche - Tiergarten - Hohenrain - T13. Station 0 on OSM node "Start-Ziel T13".
sources.width: Measured on DOP20 orthophotos of Rhineland-Palatinate (WMS https://geo4.service24.rlp.de/wms/rp_dop20.fcgi, GeoBasis-DE/LVermGeoRP, dl-de/by-2-0) from edge-line/kerb pairs every 12 m (~50% of samples; forest shadow elsewhere), gaps interpolated, clipped 7.5-14 m.
sources.elevation: DGM1 Rheinland-Pfalz 1 m airborne-LiDAR terrain model (GeoBasis-DE/LVermGeoRP, dl-de/by-2-0, https://geobasis-rlp.de/data/dgm1/current/), DHHN2016 heights; ~15 m smoothing, bridge/tunnel dips removed.
sources.camber: DGM1 RLP: crossfall from edge samples 1.2 m inside each edge vs centre, smoothed.
sources.pit: OSM "Boxengasse an T13" (Touristenfahrten / industry-pool pit lane at the T13 start-finish).
sources.trim: Race cars run medium-high downforce here (bumps, jumps, fast sweepers) - slightly above Spa.
sources.pitLimit: No pitLimit/pitLoss: none of the modelled series (F1/WEC/GT4/TCR) races on the Nordschleife-only layout in 2026; built for production-car track days.

notes: There is no official turn numbering on the Nordschleife; "corners" lists the named sections in lap order (n is a sequence number) with the apex at the tightest point of each. The 20.832 km lap is the closed Nordschleife loop through the T13 start/finish used for industry-pool and record laps (Touristenfahrten Bridge-to-Gantry is ~19.1 km of it). OSM centreline gives 20.79 km (-0.2%).
